<!-- The same code twice: the second block is a cache hit and must print the same thing. -->

```{.go .run .output}
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("cached")
}
```

```{.go .run .output}
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("cached")
}
```

<!-- Same code, different `args=` — that must *not* share a cache entry. -->

```{.go .run .output args="one"}
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(os.Args[1:])
}
```

```{.go .run .output args="two"}
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(os.Args[1:])
}
```
